senses.gloss: m. (ילף, אלף) custom, training, instruction; the Law.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 33:14">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIII, 14</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 32:6">Targ. Is. XXXII, 6</cite>; a. fr.—Y. R. Hash. IV, beg. 59ᵇ for it is impossible for one to go through his Bible lesson <he>דלא א׳</he> (read <he>בלא</he>; cmp.
<cite ref="Chagigah 3a:15">Ḥag. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>בלא חדוש</he>) without some instructive observation.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:11">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite> top <he>דלא מן א׳</he> not according to the Law.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 80">Gen. R. s. 80</cite> <he>וא׳ קבל</he> Mat. Keh. (ed. <he>ואולפין קביל</he>) and has he received traditions from teachers? <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19:1">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>אולפני מה נהיר באפי</he> how my learning shines in my face! <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:5:4">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>נישבוק אולפנה וכ׳</he> let us drop discussion and return to the Mishnah. [<cite ref="Eruvin 67a:14">Erub. 67ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>משמיה דא׳</he>, read with Ms. M. <he>דאִילְפָא</he>.]—<cite ref="A02006"><he>בר א׳</he></cite> a scholar of traditional law.
Lev. R. s. 3, beg.—Pl. אוּלְפָנַיָּיא instructive narratives, stories. Y. Kidd. 61ᵇ; Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ bot.
